name: Amos Rex
funding: Owned and run by the Amos Anderson Fund (formerly Konstsamfundet). Helsingin Sanomat is main partner; Genelec and Bauer Media Outdoor are partners.
watch: Privately funded non-profit museum established by the bequest of Amos Anderson.
records_note: Shows its main partner and partners as logos, names its owner the Amos Anderson Fund, and publishes no reports, accounts or board list.

name: Anadolu Kültür (Depo and Diyarbakır Arts Center)
funding: Founded 2002; runs Depo in Istanbul and the Diyarbakır Arts Center. Supporters named: Sigrid Rausing Trust, Civil Rights Defenders, Foundation for Arts Initiatives and Stiftung Mercator.
watch: Founder Osman Kavala has been jailed since 2017 and got a life sentence in 2022. Turkey neither funds nor controls the group.
records_note: Names its administrative board and four institutional supporters on the about page, undated; no annual reports or accounts are published.

name: Ashkal Alwan
funding: Small NGO. Major benefactors: Robert A. Matta Association, Foundation for Arts Initiatives, Andy Warhol Foundation, Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Teiger Foundation; Sfeir Semler Gallery is a patron.
watch: Sharjah Art Foundation, named in the old note, is not on it.
records_note: Ashkal Alwan names four trustees and its benefactors on an undated page, but its Annual Reports section is empty and no accounts appear.

name: Ateneo Art Gallery
funding: University museum of Ateneo de Manila University, founded 1960 on Fernando Zobel's gift of his collection; later donors, including artists, added works.
records_note: Ateneo's pages all returned 403, so its reports, accounts, funders and board could not be checked; only Wikipedia was readable.

name: Audain Art Museum
funding: Audain Foundation and Polygon Homes. Endowment founders include Onni Group, Whistler Blackcomb Foundation and the Resort Municipality of Whistler. The April 2026 gala raised C$1.5M.
watch: Purpose-built museum in Whistler, BC housing British Columbia art.
records_note: Posts four annual reports (2020-21 to 2023-24) on Issuu, lists 18 trustees, and names endowment founders by giving tier; no financial statements found.

name: Auto Italia South East
funding: Arts Council England, British Council, and non-commercial trusts. Registered Charity No. 1172824.
watch: Artist-run organisation supporting queer, trans, working-class and migrant voices. It began in a Peckham car showroom and remains independent.

name: Ayala Museum
funding: Run privately by Ayala Foundation, the Ayala group's foundation. Ayala Corporation co-presents shows; BPI is a partner. The Spanish and US embassies supported the 2024 Zóbel show.
watch: Opened 1967 from Fernando Zobel's plan. It closed in 2019 for rebuilding and reopened 4 December 2021. It had 65,000 visitors in 2014.
records_note: No records of its own; parent Ayala Foundation posts annual reports 2019 to 2024, 2024 financial statements and its trustees, with partner logos only.

name: Badischer Kunstverein
funding: City of Karlsruhe Department of Cultural Affairs, State of Baden-Württemberg, membership dues. Registered Non-Profit Association (e.V.).

name: Bag Factory Artists' Studios
funding: National Arts Council South Africa, Triangle Network, international cultural foundations, studio rentals. Registered Non-Profit Organisation (NPO).
watch: Artist-led non-profit founded in 1991, in the last years of apartheid, by David Koloane, Robert Loder and Ricky Burnett. It gave Black and white artists a shared, non-racial studio space.

name: BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art
funding: Opened July 2002 with £33.4M of Arts Council lottery capital; Gateshead Council backed the building. Corporate supporters include Tommee Tippee and NorthStandard.
watch: In March 2018 Baltic said it took no BAE money for the Great Exhibition of the North; BAE withdrew. Nissan appears only in photo captions.
records_note: No annual reports found; accounts 2021 to 2025 are on the Charity Commission register; a supporters page names funders and patrons, undated; trustees are listed.

name: Bangkok Art Biennale
funding: BAB Foundation, chaired by ThaiBev CEO Thapana Sirivadhanabhakdi; ThaiBev is main partner, with Siam Piwat and Central Group (2018). Venice 2026 show adds Bangkok city, TAT, BEM, Ch. Karnchang, Generali.
watch: Alcohol money (ThaiBev, Fraser and Neave, SABECO) is no flag. Bangkok city, a partner, censored a July 2025 BACC show, not the biennale.
records_note: No reports or accounts found; sponsors show as undated logos without names, and the BAB Foundation page lists its board members.

name: Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy
funding: Statutory body under the Ministry of Cultural Affairs, founded in 1974, governed by a minister-led Executive Council. It runs district branches, scholarships and the National Art Gallery.
watch: The venue for most Dhaka Art Summit editions, which the Samdani foundation produces.
records_note: Its government portal lists the director general, officers, projects, laws and notices; no annual reports, accounts, funder list or governing council are posted.
